title: Retire or clearly re-header the pre-refactor code samples in docs/planning/architecture-quick-reference.md and the stale tech-debt callout in architecture-offline-v2.md

evidence.quote: ### D2: Authentication — Firebase Auth (Email/Password + Google Sign-In)
Production code in `learning_tracker/lib/` currently implements the deleted March architecture — sealed `AppAuthState`, `LocalAuthGuard`, anonymous `localUid`...

why: architecture-quick-reference.md is linked from docs/index.md as a current "Reference doc" (Last Updated 2026-04-19) but its Common-Queries/Key-Data-Models sections query a single unified `db` against `db.completions`/`db.contentItems` — the pre-three-database-split, pre-multi-profile schema (grep for `db\.completions` in lib/ today returns zero hits; the Completion model shown has no profileId field at all, though profileId-in-PK is now an [E]nforced rule). D2 never mentions the cloudBorn/localBorn tiers the doc's own Project Overview names. The linked `_bmad/bmm/data/project-context-template.md` does not exist in the repo. Separately, architecture-offline-v2.md's own "Deliberate tech debt" box claims the code still implements AppAuthState/LocalAuthGuard/localUid — none of these symbols exist anywhere in lib/ (grep returns zero); the v2 target model (account_tier.dart, argon2id hash column, UpgradeToCloudService) is fully shipped. A contributor or agent following architecture-quick-reference.md's example queries would write code against a schema that no longer exists.
recommendation: In architecture-quick-reference.md: delete or clearly quarantine the Common-Queries/Key-Data-Models code samples as "Epic 1-5 historical, superseded" (the way prd.md and architecture-design.md already do), add the cloudBorn/localBorn tier split to D2, and fix or remove the dead _bmad link. In architecture-offline-v2.md: update the "Deliberate tech debt" box to state the gap has closed (cite the shipped AccountTier/UpgradeToCloudService) rather than describing a mismatch that no longer exists.
acceptance_criteria: architecture-quick-reference.md no longer shows Drift query samples against db.completions/db.contentItems as if they are current code.
The _bmad/bmm/data/project-context-template.md link resolves or is removed.

architecture-offline-v2.md's tech-debt callout reflects that AppAuthState/LocalAuthGuard/localUid are gone (verifiable via `grep -rl 'AppAuthState\|LocalAuthGuard\|localUid' learning_tracker/lib` returning empty).

corrections: Minor: the recommended acceptance-criteria grep for AppAuthState/LocalAuthGuard/localUid does not literally return empty — 6 hits remain (auth_state.dart, auth_state_provider.dart/.g.dart, auth_guard.dart), all explanatory doc-comments citing the replaced v1 names, not live classes. No `class AppAuthState`/`class LocalAuthGuard` definitions exist. Core claim still holds; recommendation's literal verification command needs adjusting.
